title: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Scope of Application) Article 3(1) of the "Regulations on Prevention and Resolution of Conflicts in Public Institutions" (hereinafter referred to as "the Regulations") refers to the following institutions designated by the Prime Minister's decree:

1. Institutions under the President: Broadcasting and Media Communications Committee
2. Institutions under the Prime Minister: Office for National Affairs, Financial Supervisory Service
